findings.title: update_profile re-caches the pre-update profile, so reads stay stale for the whole TTL
findings.trigger: With a TTLCache wired in (the production default from build_service), call update_profile and then get_profile. update_profile deletes the key, then reads through self.get_profile, which misses and stores the current (old) profile under the same key before the new one is saved.
findings.impact: Every edit is invisible to readers, including the editing user, for up to TEAMDIR_PROFILE_CACHE_TTL seconds (300 by default); the PR's stated invalidation does not happen. Load from the store directly and delete the key after save.

findings.title: The invalidation test runs without a cache, so it passes whether or not invalidation works
findings.trigger: make_service() is called with no cache argument, so DirectoryService uses NullCache and every read goes to the store.
findings.impact: The test cannot catch the stale read above; pass a TTLCache as test_repeat_reads_are_served_from_cache does.
